text.p: Evergreen Media Corp and Chancellor Broadcasting Co said Monday that they entered into a definitive agreement with Katz Media Group Inc under which a jointly owned affiliate of Evergreen and Chancellor will acquire Katz.
The transaction is valued at about $373 million, a news release issued by the companies said.
Katz Media will ultimately be owned by Chancellor, the companies said.
Katz Media will retain its name, organisational identity, management team, personnel, New York headquarters and 65 regional sales offices, the companies said.

Under the terms of the agreement, which was unanimously approved by the boards of each of the three companies, Evergreen and Chancellor will acquire Katz Media through a tender offer in which Katz Media shareholders will receive $11.00 in cash for each share they hold, the companies said.
